title: Smoke gradually decreasing in most areas
snippet: Some promising trends are in the forecast as we close out the weekend. As stated in yesterday's post (see below), the upper level winds are transporting the heaviest smoke to the north of Colorado. Additionally, afternoon showers and thunderstorms are starting to increase with monsoonal moisture being pumped into the state.
